about: Playtest scenarios for `bash scripts/game/playtest.sh`. Each is `ak create` run with these arguments, so the Allocator prices every level and the personas build it as they would for a player. {A} is the player's affinity and {B} its opposite; {C} and {D} are another opposed pair. The seed picks the affinities, so every affinity comes up across runs. tests/simulations/playtest-scenarios.test.mjs builds and runs each one with every affinity as the player's; `knownIssues` lists rule breaks still open, as tests/simulations/scenarios do.

scenarios.title: First look
focus: Walk both rooms and find the exit: does fog and sight feel right?
Read the HUD: do the vitals, regen and slot lines match what happens?
Take the resource (g) and check the vital it raises.
Get near the warden: does it notice you, and what does its push do?

scenarios.title: Walking through fields
focus: Stand in each hazard's field: does the HUD change the way the colour suggests?
Walk your own {A} field into the {B} hazard: do they cancel on the cells between?
Watch durability and health: which vital takes the hit first?
Leave your emit on until mana drains: does it switch off, and back on when full?

knownIssues.note: hazards seated inside each other's reach; on some seeds only

scenarios.title: Duel with a warden
focus: Cast push and pull at the warden (f, Tab, Enter): does the hit match the panel?
Change range and intensity in the list (i, then + - ] [): does the mana cost follow?
Run out of mana mid-fight: what can you still do?
Win or lose: is the end of the fight clear on screen?

scenarios.title: Party and orders
focus: Switch between your two delvers (Tab): does the view and HUD follow?
Order the companion (o): follow, guard, then change its order mid-game.
Does the companion help, get in the way, or get stuck?
Get everyone to the exit: is it clear who has left?

scenarios.title: Long haul
focus: Play to the exit or to defeat: is the pacing fun, or does it drag?
Rest when stamina runs low: is recovery worth the turns?
Do the wardens defend sensibly, or loop or stall?
Note anything priced oddly: too strong, too weak, too cheap.
